name: Museum For A Rainy Day
summary:
The Museum For A Rainy Day is a curated digital museum featuring exhibitions by living independent artists from around the world.

Explore complete gallery floors designed to be experienced at your own pace — without travel, tickets, or closing hours.

From painting and photography to illustration and printmaking, every exhibition is presented as a unified body of work inside an immersive museum environment built for spatial computing and modern devices.

Free to visit. Curated with care.
